description: Ministry of Labour - Industrial Dispute between 1 ) Five workers and Sri Lanka Transport Board. 2) Three workers and Ceylon Fishery Harbours Corporation
categorisation: The gazette content is an order made under Section 4(1) of the Industrial Disputes Act, appointing an arbitrator to settle specific industrial disputes. It is a formal exercise of regulatory power granted by an existing law (the Industrial Disputes Act). The core of the document is the issuance of a legal/regulatory instrument (the Order) to implement a statutory process, which fits the definition of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5). While it names a Minister performing an action, the primary purpose is not a government personnel change (Type 2) or a hybrid appointment with detailed portfolio responsibilities (Type 3); it is the execution of a regulatory function under a specific Act.
